## Before posting / Перед публикацией

**This issue is public. / Эта заявка публичная.**

Do not include API keys, passwords, access tokens, personal data, customer records, private code, or confidential screenshots. Use a public source or a genuinely synthetic example. Do not paste signed URLs or links containing credentials. If the task cannot be described safely, do not post it here.

Не прикладывайте ключи, пароли, токены, персональные данные, закрытый код, клиентские записи и конфиденциальные скриншоты. Нужен открытый источник или полностью вымышленный пример. Если безопасно описать задачу нельзя, не публикуйте её здесь.

- [ ] I checked the text, links, and attachments: they contain no confidential information or personal data, and I have permission to share them publicly.
- [ ] I understand that this is a proposal, not a booking, a response-time promise, a grant of system access, or consent to publish a participant case study.

These checkboxes are a self-check, not an automated privacy filter. English or Russian is welcome. No email address or other private contact information is needed.

## One task / Одна задача

What single problem should be investigated, and for whom?

## Safe source and version / Безопасный источник и версия

Public repository or document URL plus commit SHA/version, or a short synthetic specification. Check the URL itself for secrets. Do not attach private originals.

## Expected artifact and acceptance / Результат и приёмка

Complete: "Done means I have …, and I can check it by …"

List up to three observable acceptance checks. Distinguish a proposed test from a test that was actually executed.

## Boundaries and unknowns / Границы и неизвестное

What may be read or changed? What is out of scope? What questions remain unanswered?

The default is read-only investigation of the public example. No production changes, purchases, credential access, or external messages are authorized by this issue.

## Human review / Проверка человеком

Who will accept or reject the result? A role or public GitHub handle is enough; do not add personal details. If no reviewer is available, say so.

## What you tried / Что уже пробовали

Optional: one sanitized attempt and its observed result. Label assumptions and unexecuted checks explicitly.

## Measurement / Измерение

Has a comparable human-only baseline already been recorded before the assisted run? Answer yes, no, or not applicable. Do not estimate savings retrospectively. Without a valid baseline, no time-saved or ROI claim will be made.

---

Maintainer triage: narrow or decline unsafe/out-of-scope tasks; agree scope and capacity before starting. A formal pilot additionally requires the repository's screening, consent, safety, and baseline gates. Submitting this issue does not bypass them or authorize case-study publication.
